notes:
# Warn whoever is at your Mac {speaker.wave.2}
When Guard this Mac sees someone, tap Warn them on the alert or the remote,
and your Mac says out loud that it is being monitored.

# Your own warning {text.bubble}
Write your own words in Settings › Guard, and try them with Hear It.

---

Everything else in this release:

- The guard no longer switches itself off when it sees someone.
- The warning plays at full volume, then your volume goes back as it was.
